analysis.environment_reference_bank: Four seed entries (titanic_staircase_001, ghibli_kitchen_001, gonegi_harbor_dock_001, mori_forest_clearing_001) provide validation reference targets; recall rules require minimum anchor match against bank descriptors.
analysis.environment_similarity_binding: environment_similarity_v1 governs same_environment_threshold=0.98 vs similarity_threshold=0.85; validation must not treat similar_environment scores as identity lock.
analysis.environment_traceability_binding: traceability_signature links conditioning_map_ref and ENVIRONMENT_REFERENCE_BANK_SPECIFICATION for batch audit without GPU execution in this phase.
analysis.environment_runtime_channel: STRICT environment_identity runtime channel from VIDEO_CONDITIONING_BACKEND; first campaign stage with batch_size=50 and hard-tier primary Movie Reconstruction target.

environment_validation_contract.scope: Validation definition only — Validation Defined != Validation Executed.
environment_validation_contract.gpu_execution: false — protocol and dataset plan only; execution deferred to future GPU-enabled phase.

same_environment_criteria.same_environment: Score >= 0.98 required for same-environment identity lock certification.
same_environment_criteria.reference_bank_match: Exact environment_id or layout_signature match with reference_bank_match_score >= 0.98.
same_environment_criteria.same_environment_score: Primary measurement: reference_bank_match_score gated at same_environment threshold.
same_environment_criteria.assessment_note: Same Environment Defined != Same Environment Achieved.

similar_environment_criteria.similar_environment: Score in [0.80, 0.98) classifies as similar but NOT same environment.
similar_environment_criteria.similarity_threshold: Scores >= 0.85 trigger similar_environment degradation path review.
similar_environment_criteria.strict_environment: Score in [0.95, 0.98) is strict-but-not-identical; logged for anchor tuning.
similar_environment_criteria.different_environment: Score < 0.50 classifies as different_environment; triggers fallback_environment.

environment_failure_criteria.geometry_mismatch: Anchor normalized_position delta exceeds STRICT bound.
environment_failure_criteria.style_overrides_identity: Style conditioning weight dominates IP-Adapter environment reference weight.
environment_failure_criteria.different_staircase: Hard-tier failure example: wrong architectural identity.
environment_failure_criteria.missing_railing: Hard-tier failure example: anchor descriptor missing from output.
environment_failure_criteria.hallucinated_architecture: Hard-tier failure example: invented structure not in reference bank.

reference_bank_recall_rules.recall_method: Match generated output anchors against reference bank anchor_descriptors; count kind+importance matches >= minimum_anchor_match across required_reference_count bank entries per batch.
